g.text: • Documents, embeddings and the index stay in uploads/ on your laptop.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Voice audio is processed in memory and never saved.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Chat history lives only in the browser tab.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Only exception: a fact check sends the question text to Wikipedia / DuckDuckGo.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c7771b
font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • A 9B model can still be wrong: sources are shown so you can check.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Scanned PDFs need OCR first; OCR is not built in.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Quizzes are slow by design (each question is self-checked).

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Quiz answers are clicked; answering by voice is not built yet.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f1724

g.text: • Single user on localhost; search is sized for a course's worth of files.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #556074

g.text: Yapperton · local RAG + voice assistant · Flask · Ollama · Whisper · Kokoro
